title.zh: Bernie Sanders Pushes Bill to Ban Advanced AI Development
title.en: Bernie Sanders Pushes Bill to Ban Advanced AI Development

current_state.zh: Sen. Bernie Sanders introduced legislation to permanently ban artificial superintelligence and temporarily pause advanced AI development pending federal safety rules, with penalties up to 20 years in prison.
